body:
FileMaker

Start here. Everything else is under Advanced Tools.

Build a Web App

Make a web form that writes to FileMaker, without editing code or JSON.

Choose a starter, pick sample data or your own layout, then preview the form.

Connect and Test

Reach your FileMaker server and find out why a connection does not work.

Save a server address and let the extension test it before you commit.

Browse Data

Find, read and change records in the database you connected to.

Build a find with a form and open the result in a table.

Help

Guided setup, the manual, and what the extension is doing.

The guided steps from a fresh install to your first query.
Advanced Tools

Setup

Project setup and the settings that shape what the extension may do.

Create the .fmweb folder in the workspace.
